title: Employee access
instructions: Select the camera, its access controller, and an allowed door. Look directly at the selected camera. Only one person may be in view.
noDoors: No available doors are assigned to your account. Contact your administrator.
verifying: Looking for a usable face: {{seconds}} seconds remaining
continue: You may continue with the cardless access process.

errors.login_failed: Sign-in failed. Check your credentials or contact your administrator.
errors.session_expired: Your session expired or was revoked. Please sign in again.
errors.system_disabled: Cardless access is currently disabled. Contact your administrator.
errors.no_registered_face: You do not have a registered face. Ask your administrator to register your face before using cardless access.
errors.recognition_unavailable: Face verification is currently unavailable. Contact your administrator.
errors.controller_unavailable: The access controller is unavailable. Please try again later.
errors.snapshot_failed: Unable to capture a fresh camera snapshot. Please try again.
errors.detection_unavailable: Person detection is unavailable. Please try again later.
errors.no_person: No person was detected. Stand in front of the selected camera and try again.
errors.multiple_persons: More than one person was detected. Only one person may be in view.
errors.multiple_faces: More than one face was detected. Only one person may be in view.
errors.face_not_detected: Failed to detect a face. Please face the camera and try again.
errors.identity_not_verified: Your identity could not be verified with sufficient confidence. Please face the camera and try again.
errors.access_denied: The selected camera, controller, or door is not available to your account.
errors.policy_changed: Your access settings or face enrollment changed. Please start a new verification.
errors.operation_interrupted: This operation was interrupted. Check the door before starting a new verification.
errors.operation_in_progress: A verification is already in progress. Please wait for its result.
errors.request_conflict: This access request has already been used. Start a new verification.
errors.door_outcome_unknown: The unlock result is unknown. Check the door before trying again.
errors.door_command_failed: The controller did not accept the unlock command. Contact your administrator.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.invalid_csrf: Your sign-in page expired. Reload the page and try again.
errors.invalid_request: This access request is invalid. Reload the page and try again.
errors.service_unavailable: The employee service is unavailable. Please try again later.
errors.connection_lost: The connection was lost and the unlock result is unknown. Check the door before trying again.
